sentences.text: A few terms, and one formula you’ll use on every trip.
The range of the tide is the difference between high water and low water.
Charted depths are measured from mean lower low water.
Heights and bridge clearances are measured from mean high water.
The actual depth at any moment equals the charted depth plus the height of tide.
Can the height of tide be a negative number?
A minus tide means the water is below mean lower low water, so it’s shallower than the chart says.
It happens around spring tides, especially with a strong offshore wind.
And the stand of the tide is the short pause at high or low water, when the level barely changes.
